description: Act on the Arx admin account watch: approve (wpUserId: an unexpected admin was you or your team, it becomes expected), demote (wpUserId: take admin rights away, the account becomes a subscriber and is signed out; not the last administrator), lock (wpUserId: freeze the account: no roles, signed out, random password, no app passwords; unfreeze later in oma_arx_security_change), app_password_revoke (wpUserId + uuid from appPasswords, or uuid all), app_password_policy (policy all, admins or off: who may use application passwords), approve_file (path of a must-use plugin or drop-in you checked), refresh (read the accounts again now), mark_staff (Lanetti support only: an account Lanetti support made). Confirm required. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: approve (unexpected admin was you), demote (admin rights off), lock (freeze), app_password_revoke (wpUserId + uuid or all), app_password_policy (policy), approve_file (path), refresh (read again), mark_staff (Lanetti support only).

policy.description: app_password_policy: who may use application passwords.

uuid.description: app_password_revoke: id from appPasswords, or all.

wpUserId.description: WordPress user id from oma_arx_admin_watch admins.

name: oma_arx_admin_watch_change
title: Act on Arx admin accounts
